admission.justification: A recovery notice pointing at a removed gate tool would strand an installation or reintroduce the old control plane.

applicability: Former session lifecycle/gate artifacts found in an installation after their owners are removed.
conditions: No current product route decides an old stored gate.
Name leftover gate files and the explicit user-owned removal command.
exclusions: Task and landing lifecycle contracts retain their separate current owners.
statement: The functions behind the lifecycle tools and the gate store are removed with the hooks that called them and with their place in the dashboard; no part of the product decides a stored gate any more, and where a gate log remains the product says so and names the command.
